_note: EXTERNAL verification policy. The producing agent must NOT be able to write this file (in production: branch-protected / CODEOWNERS / harness-owned path). A receipt may only NAME a claim_kind; it may NOT declare its own verification command. claim_verify resolves the argv from HERE, never from the receipt.

audit_policy._note: tier4 admits an audit only if (1) its verdict token is exact, (2) its auditor identity differs from the receipt producer, and (3) a current evalcheck calibration receipt for that auditor exists against a sealed deck.
